acceptance: No inbox item write outside internal/inboxmover (a test walks the module for writes to .evolve/inbox items)
A recurrence reweight appends an inbox-lifecycle ledger line and passes the weight rule
fix: Route the recurrence reweight through inboxmover (an Edit-like facade taking the weight, or a loop-owned weight stamp in the owner table), with its ledger line; decide in the ADR whether a loop reweight is a curation or a stamp.
summary: internal/recurrence/apply.go setItemWeight rewrites .evolve/inbox items' weight with atomicwrite.JSON at the wave boundary: a second item writer outside inboxmover, writing a curator-owned field (ADR-0116's owner table). Under ADR-0112's sync a plane-side reweight is not IsMoverWritten, so it is other dirt that blocks sync-main, and it bypasses edit's validation and ledger line.
title: The recurrence engine reweights inbox items through its own writer, although the field-owner table gives weight to the curator
